title: A Lambda function's CloudWatch metrics over a window

periodSeconds.description: The CloudWatch period of each datapoint: 300 up to a 3-day window, 3600 above. The window is not aligned to the period, so the first datapoint can cover less than a full period (a partial first bucket) and the last is still filling

hasData.description: Invocations has datapoints in the window; false: CloudWatch has nothing for the function (not invoked, or the metrics are not in yet); null when the Invocations call failed

idle.description: invocations is 0 (no datapoints, or none counted): the function ran nothing in the window; null when the Invocations call failed. An idle function says nothing about errors

invocations.description: Sum of Invocations; 0 with no datapoints (hasData false); null when the call failed. Throttled calls are not invocations

errors.description: Sum of Errors (invocations that raised, timed out or crashed); 0 with no Errors datapoints only when Invocations has datapoints; null when the call failed or when there was no data at all

throttles.description: Sum of Throttles; its own datapoints when it has them, else 0 only when Invocations has datapoints; null when the call failed or when there was no data at all

errorRate.description: errors / invocations; null when there were no invocations or a count is unknown

averageMs.description: Average weighted by each datapoint's sample count

duration.description: null when the Duration call failed

concurrentExecutionsMax.description: Highest ConcurrentExecutions (Maximum) in the window; null with no datapoints or when the call failed

datapoints.description: Datapoints CloudWatch returned per metric; 0 means no data in the window (a function that was not invoked publishes none); null means the call failed

errorRateAboveThreshold.description: errorRate > the errorRateThreshold setting (strictly: equal is not above); null when the rate is unknown, which includes any window with no invocations

throttlesAboveThreshold.description: throttles >= the throttleThreshold setting; null when throttles is null

durationNearTimeout.description: The longest invocation reached durationTimeoutRatio of the function's timeout; null when there was no Duration data or the call failed
